population.rule: outfield, minutes >= 900 (league) or >= 270 (tournament), complete feature vector

features.scaling: StandardScaler (z-score) fitted on the pooled modeling population

clustering.selection_rule: highest silhouette among eligible candidates (min cluster share 3%, DBSCAN noise <= 10%); Davies-Bouldin breaks ties
clustering.stage_note: Global clustering (reported here) mostly separates positions. Archetypes come from a second stage that clusters each position group separately in its own PCA(90%) space, k in 2..6 chosen by silhouette.

archetypes.name: Stopper Centre-Back
archetypes.description: Mostly players whose profile is defined by aerial contribution, with comparatively little possession involvement, carrying.

archetypes.name: Progressive Full-Back
archetypes.description: Mostly players whose profile is defined by chance creation, dribbling, pressing, with comparatively little aerial contribution, passing.

archetypes.name: Deep-Lying Playmaker
archetypes.description: Mostly players whose profile is defined by passing, carrying, possession involvement, with comparatively little pressing, defensive activity.

archetypes.name: Ball-Winning Midfielder
archetypes.description: Mostly players whose profile is defined by a balanced profile, with comparatively little passing, possession involvement.

archetypes.name: Advanced Playmaker
archetypes.description: Mostly players whose profile is defined by passing, possession involvement, ball progression, with comparatively little defensive activity, aerial contribution.

archetypes.name: Progressive Creator
archetypes.description: Mostly players whose profile is defined by carrying, ball progression, possession involvement, with comparatively little aerial contribution.

archetypes.name: Wide Worker
archetypes.description: Mostly players whose profile is defined by a balanced profile, with comparatively little carrying, ball progression.

archetypes.name: Poacher
archetypes.description: Mostly players whose profile is defined by a balanced profile, with comparatively little possession involvement, carrying.

archetypes.name: Complete Forward
archetypes.description: Mostly players whose profile is defined by possession involvement, carrying, ball progression, with comparatively little pressing, defensive activity.

clustering.archetype_naming: cosine match between each cluster's position-relative DNA centroid (z-scored within its position group) and a signature lexicon restricted to that position group; names are unique per group

similarity.validation: self-retrieval: for players with 2+ qualifying seasons, does another season of the same player appear in the top-5 neighbours of a query season?
similarity.percent_formula: 100 * (1 - F(distance)) where F is the empirical CDF of distances between 200,000 random player-season pairs

clustering.selection_rule: highest silhouette among eligible candidates with 3-6 clusters (min cluster share 8%, ≤10% DBSCAN noise); Davies-Bouldin breaks ties
